letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still smile thinking of the sparkle in your eyes when we said “I do” on that golden February day, and I cherish each moment we weave together across two cities. You are my compass, my laughter, my home—no matter where we are, my heart beats only for you. Thank you for making every day feel like a sweet adventure.
poem:
Across the dunes and rivers wide,  
Your love’s the tide I ride,  
In every smile, in every sigh,  
Together, forever, you and I.
